text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Believe-san, Dantsu-san. Thank you so 
much... for the art supplies."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Happy birthday, Cafe-chan! I was so 
happy you drew a picture for me in return 
right away~!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It was masterful. The light, the 
shadow... and the black cat.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“—Huh? Wait... there's a painting... in 
front of the room...”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
E-Eeeek!? Then could the person who drew 
that be... Cafe-chan's... 'f-friend'...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“—N-No, I'm not scared, not scared at 
all~! They just drew a picture to 
celebrate my birthday. ...R-Right?!”

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I, too, felt a genuine sincerity in 
those brushstrokes. Even if it wasn't the 
work of human hands."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I'll give you another gift. An art 
supply kit. Since it seems you need one.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, yeah! Working on a joint piece 
together could be super fun too!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you, everyone. I'm sure... she 
would be delighted too."
